intro: Fel Cones are corrupted seed pods that drop from the boughs of Teldrassil, easily spotted by the noxious green fumes drifting from their hulls. Though foul and tainted by dark energies, local night elf defenders find clever uses for them against nearby tricksters.

p: Teldrassil is young, but corruption has already seeped into its living wood. Fel Cones are the visible evidence of this insidious rot—gnarled, fallen pine cones that billow with foul green smoke. Scattered beneath the boughs just east of Dolanaar, these pods are steeped in tainted magic that warps natural flora and makes them dangerous to touch or consume without caution.
